imported_principles: question/tension -> answer/contribution -> evidence chain -> boundary -> meaning
exact target criteria before editorial simulation
editorial triage separate from peer-review simulation
independent review lenses frozen before synthesis where isolation is available
minimum scientifically sufficient repair rather than cosmetic experiment accumulation
analogue papers as structural/evidence priors rather than wording templates
terminology ledger and whole-manuscript consistency sweep
figure/statistics/data availability as separate quality instruments
stop instead of polishing when decisive evidence is missing or score improvement plateaus
non_imported_claims: No external skill score is treated as journal acceptance probability
No Nature branding in the donor repository is treated as evidence of Nature-level readiness
No donor instruction may strengthen ORION scientific claims beyond their receipt-backed evidence
No published analogue wording or distinctive figure design may be copied
